candidates.title: Prepare customer updates from changing order data

demandEvidence.chore: Prepare customer-facing status updates when order data is incomplete or changes frequently.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: I’d be interested to hear how others handle customer-facing status updates when internal operational data is incomplete or changes frequently.

ease.reason: A beginner could draft an update from operator-supplied sample order states, but the post supplies no implementation reference or integration details.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: small online stores may pay for clearer status updates; this discussion establishes a need, not willingness to pay.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock can draft from synthetic order-state rows; changing data rules, store access and customer delivery remain untested.

autonomy.reason: A proposed row-to-message draft is repeatable, but no trigger or messaging capability is documented and a human must verify and send each update.

evidence.reason: The post explicitly identifies customer status updates amid incomplete or changing operational data, but gives no frequency, fields or corroboration.

candidates.reason: Below threshold on this limited evidence, and duplicate: the ecommerce customer and customer-status communication workflow match prior post 98b4f6281cc3de4ecdfa95f6.
